caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, mountains patterned as dense forest, a bearded figure emerging from the mouth of a great fish beneath a flowering tree, winged attendants above and rocky slopes set with herbs around, cinnabar red, malachite green, azurite blue, ochre, jade white
notes_zh: 《约拿出鱼口》页(Jami al-Tavarikh, Commons PD)：花树下先知出鱼口，有翼侍者与山石草木。
